name: Gob

identification.note: Not identified with any known modern site; some manuscripts and the parallel account in 1 Chronicles 20:4 read "Gezer" instead.

related_people.name: Elhanan
related_people.role: killed the Gittite giant Lahmi in the fighting here

related_people.name: Jonathan
related_people.role: David's nephew, who killed a taunting giant of Gath in battle here

related_people.name: Saph
related_people.role: a Philistine giant killed by Sibbecai in the fighting here

related_people.name: Sibbecai
related_people.role: one of David's men, who struck down the giant Saph here

description: The site of battles between David's men and Philistine giants descended from the Rapha, including Elhanan's killing of Goliath's brother Lahmi (2 Samuel 21:18-22).
